body.mechanism: R2 can be causal and reproducible only if each NWP source exposes physically comparable vertical vectors and a documented fixed target height; otherwise interpolation/PCA mixes incompatible semantics.
body.treatment: Static docs, headers, feature-manifest and prior-receipt prerequisite audit.
body.metric: Boolean documentation, comparability, bracketing/extrapolation, duplication and provenance gates; no model score.
